mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the two dust populations was most worthwhile: it brought their separate histories together in a faint glow between worlds.

leastWorthwhile.text: Grinding leftover stones into dust felt familiar after the earlier collision outcomes, though it made sense.

surprise.text: The debris struck the giant's rings and sprayed ice, rather than simply being scattered by its gravity as I expected.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt clearly arbitrary; the final dust combination had a clear purpose once both ingredients appeared.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see where the connected material histories lead, though the repeated collision outcomes were less engaging.
